trigger: Technical preflight found source histories where the exact scheduled 30/60/90-minute M15 bar-open does not exist. Candidate evaluation stopped before metrics were generated.

execution_policy.normal_case: Use the exact scheduled checkpoint M15 bar-open executable Bid/Ask.
execution_policy.missing_exact_checkpoint: Use the first available market M15 bar-open at or after the scheduled checkpoint, because no executable market bar exists at the scheduled time.
execution_policy.candidate_state_effect: The actual delayed close time is used when computing candidate-adjusted exposure state for later entries.
